title: Philosophy of Religion
description: A general introduction to the philosophy of religion through the study of classical and/or contemporary texts. Among the issues to be discussed are the existence and nature of God, the problem of evil, the existence of miracles, the relation between reason and revelation, and the nature of religious language. May be repeated for credit two times with change of content. Prerequisites: upper-division standing or consent of instructor. May be taken for credit twice with changed content.
